notes.title: Playtonic games in Cozy Quest event 14th-18th November!
notes.content:
Good day, Playtonic Friends game enjoyers!

Do you happen to have a penchant for cozy games? Of course you do! What better way to escape the persistant horrors of reality than by fully immersing yourself in the fictional whimsy of another world?! 

Coincidentally, in support of this, and our good friend capitalism, a number of (Four, to be precise) Playtonic Friends titles are taking part in the Cozy Quest Steam event, run by our good friends at Secret Mode! 

Let's have a wee gander at what games we're serving to you on a Cozy platter!

[h3]Cattle Country (Open Beta)[/h3]

Play Cattle Country's Open Beta for FREE! It's only running for until the 18th of November so go make the most of that one right now! Travel to a new frontier and settle down among the forests and rivers of Cattle Country, build up your ranch, nurture crops and relationships with your fellow settlers and see what the quieter country life is all about. This one is perfect for fans of farming sims with a cowboy twist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country

[h3]Lil Gator Game[/h3]

This one needs no introduction! It's Lil Gator Game!

Okay, a bit of introduction... Lil Gator Game places you in charge of, wait for it, a cute Lil Gator, on a journey of adventure and friendship, often combing the two! (Friendventure?) Take on cardboard cut-out "monsters", gather your friends and finally get to play together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

[h3]Blossom Tales II: The Minotaur Prince[/h3]

Castle Pixel's second entry in this list (They're developing Cattle Country!) is Blossom Tales II! If you're a fan of classic adventure RPGs with a little green guy, this one is for you! Join Lily and slash your way through monster-infested dungeons to save the Kingdom of Blossom from eternal darkness. It's a lot cozier than that sounds... I promise.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/446810/Blossom_Tales_The_Sleeping_King/

[h3]A Little Golf Journey[/h3]

Golf is sport and sport doesn't sound all that cozy or relaxing to me BUT A Little Golf Journey is here to subvert all of my preconceptions! Take on light golfing challenges and puzzles across beautiful diarama based courses. Tweak the settings and difficulty to your desired level, sit back and golf!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232150/A_Little_Golf_Journey/

Thanks for checking out our lovely little list of Cozy Quest games! If you want to peak at the whole list of games taking part in the event, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SecretMode/sale/CozyQuest2024]get your clicking finger on this link![/url]

notes.title: A New Way to Play A Little Golf Journey
notes.content:
Hey golfers!

Put down your putter for a minute because we have an exciting announcement to share with you all. We have partnered with Tilt 5 to bring you a brand new way to experience A Little Golf Journey.

The Tilt 5 system brings holographic gaming right to your table! Ever wanted to have a birds-eye view over treetops or pyramids? Now you can with this immersive experience!

The system comes with a gameboard, glasses and a wand, although you can use your own controller if you'd prefer. All you have to do is unfold the gameboard, connect the glasses to a PC or Android device, and start playing. It's that easy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37387380/689ca0b437e3f6e7549d905c9df56ab2fe81c0d2.png[/img]

Want to find out more? Head on over to the Tilt 5 website for more information and find out how you can reserve your Tilt 5 system [url=https://www.tiltfive.com/the-system]here[/url].

And that's not all! For this week only, A Little Golf Journey has a whopping [b]40% OFF![/b] It's never been a better time to sit back, relax and be transported to stunning locations from the comfort of your own home.


- Okidokico & Playtonic Friends

notes.title: Golfing on the go
notes.content:
Hey golfers, 

We can't believe that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232150/A_Little_Golf_Journey/]A Little Golf Journey[/url] has been out for almost an entire year! Where has the time gone?!

Today we have some exciting news for you, A Little Golf Journey has been officially verified for the Steam Deck!

What does being verified for the Steam Deck mean? It means that A Little Golf Journey has had Valve's seal of approval that it's optimised in every way possible to play seamlessly. You can golf wherever you want, from your sofa or at the park, on an aeroplane, and beyond! The world is your oyster, or golf ball if we're sticking to golf-related puns.

Golfing on the go? We'd love to see where you take A Little Golf Journey, so please tag us in pictures on social media - that includes any astronauts reading this. We'd love to have some space shots!


Happy golfing :-)

- Playtonic Friends

notes.title: A Little Stats Journey
notes.content:
Hi golfers!
		
It feels like we've been on our Little Golf Journey for a long time, but the end is nearly in sight now. Sorry, we can't announce a release date just yet - we will do so soon! But since we were recently able to get our first 100% playthrough of the game (completing, unlocking, and collecting everything) I thought I'd share a few stats about what you can expect from A Little Golf Journey.
		
[list]
[*]There are [b]400 stars[/b] to collect in the game. Not every star is found in a golf hole! We worked hard to round it up to a nice number. Somehow 387 stars didn't look quite as satisfying.
[*]There are [b]61 Blue Things[/b] to collect in the game. What is a Blue Thing? We don't know, but I'm sure they'll be useful along your journey in some way... And yes, I admit, we didn't do a great job of rounding this up to a nice number.
[*]There are [b]9 locations[/b] to explore and 1 secret location that you'll discover on your travels.
[*]There are [b]109 golf holes[/b] to play. You'll actually find more levels than that, but I don't want to spoil all the surprises yet.
[*]It took our playtesters about [b]15 hours[/b] to 100% the game through normal play the first time.
[*]There are [b]22 original compositions[/b] of music for in the game. You can expect to see a post soon all about the music!
[*]The soundtrack lasts a total of about [b]70 minutes[/b]. Originally we weren't going to have any music at all, so that's probably the most impressive statistic of the bunch. Thanks to Haakon for that!
[*]We have [b]12 achievements[/b] to complete of varying difficulty.
[*]The game is localized into [b]8 languages[/b] right now.
[*]There are [b]3 core challenge[/b] types, with some of them having variations.
[*]Our world map covers approximately [b]1 square kilometer[/b] of space (it looked more impressive when I initially calculated it to be 1 million square meters!). We didn't build anything to scale, though. I couldn't tell you if the golf ball is life-sized or if the trees are life-sized.
[*]There are exactly [b]10,764m of paths[/b] for the ball to roll along on the world map.
[/list]

notes.title: Latest news and updates!
notes.content:
Hi golfers!
		
While we've been very busy lately, I thought I'd share with you some images from the game showing the progress we've made in one area in particular. Here you can see a couple of screenshots from the Forest of Mist, our Wales inspired location full of cobbled castles, fields of flowers, and a mist that gently kisses the lakes with a magical silvery hue! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37387380/d474f9423ee112e65e0e7936e8363be6b5751b8b.png[/img]
		
I'm not sure what that wisp is doing in this next image. I've heard that wisps can sometimes lead people to hidden treasures...
		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37387380/7eb59929bdd17968e08acc32c3ad266ac5772931.png[/img]

Also Haakon, our composer, has created a couple of haunting Celtic inspired melodies for this location. You can listen to one here:

[url=https://soundcloud.com/haakond/fairytale?in=haakond/sets/alittlegolfjourney]Fairytale by Haakon Davidsen[/url]
		
Finally, we had a bit of recent publicity, which I can share with you in one nice handy place:
		
[list]
[*]It was a lot of fun to participate in the Tiny Teams festival recently, and to see our game being played in its near final state. You can check out the fun on a Twitch stream here: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1114888273?t=2h19m31s]https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1114888273?t=2h19m31s[/url]
[*]We had a chance to talk about our game to Martin Robinson at Eurogamer who wrote an article about us here, which dives into the escapism of golf and what makes this game different from all the other golf games: [url=https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2021-08-12-a-little-golf-journey-strips-back-all-the-stress-of-the-sport]https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2021-08-12-a-little-golf-journey-strips-back-all-the-stress-of-the-sport[/url]
[*]Stacey Henley from The Gamer also wrote a piece about us here, where we talk a bit more about our journey as a studio: [url=https://www.thegamer.com/interview-a-little-golf-journey-far-cry/]https://www.thegamer.com/interview-a-little-golf-journey-far-cry/[/url]
[/list]

Happy golfing!
		
Charles - Okidokico

notes.title: Game update and exciting announcement
notes.content:
It's been a while dearest golfers!  

First of all: Happy New Year! 

We'd like to wish you health, happiness and serenity for this year and many more to come! Here's to a decade full of birdies and albatrosses ♥

Second, long overdue news about the game! Don't worry, It's still happening! We've actually been busy making some major changes that we're pretty excited to share with you very soon.

Our goal with this game has always been to make it a fun and unique golfing experience and as part of this process we had to take the difficult decision to drop multiplayer for launch so we can focus on making the single player experience the best it can be.

We'll be revealing more about these changes over the next few weeks and you'll get a chance to try it out for yourselves during this year's Steam Spring Games Festival as we'll be participating with an all new demo! 

Thanks a lot for your patience and support and check back very soon to learn more about the exciting new features and everything that's coming!

- Charles - Okidokico

notes.title: Dev Blog - Welcome to the Grid...
notes.content:
Now that the Steam Summer Games Festival is behind us, we're hard at work getting the game ready for release and I thought it'd be nice to share more on our process & progress. 

Production is in full swing on one of our brand new courses; [b]ARES-1980X[/b]. 

Built as a homage to the futuristic VR movies of the 80s (such as [i]TRON[/i]), this course features a rich synth soundscape, neon-glow colours and even big dangerous snakes that you'll have to golf around.

We're currently blocking out the layouts, which means translating the 2d plans into 3d space, measuring out the shots, placing down obstacles, etc.

Here's a tiny preview of one of the holes (I believe it's ARES-1980X - Hole 03):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37387380/15d2c8fdb39a3b08852714303044a0b4ebdd3abc.gif[/img]

Sorry for the tiny size - Steam's limit is 3MB - but be sure to keep an eye for more updates!

Last but not least, I'd like to give a huge thanks to everyone who tried the demo - it was great to see so many of play and share your thoughts. Keep the word going and feel free to join us on the forums or on discord (https://discord.gg/65ns33E)!

Ave,

- Moussa

notes.title: Yarn Golf course
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A while ago we told you about our wishlist campaign and of our create an extra golf course at launch if enough people add us to their wishlists. Well, here's a sneak peak of what that course would look like.

[previewyoutube=Dv-1AtbG3Ko;full][/previewyoutube]

We don't have a name for it yet (internally we just call it yarn-land), but we picked this style because it's a very different look from the other locations but still fits with the relaxing atmosphere of the game. It just "felt" right!

We'd like to do a lot more with the course than it just being a simple reskinning. Our goal is to have the ball trail look like string and for all particle effects to also have a stringy look to them as well as there being a nice feature object, like a wooly house.

If you have any suggestions for what fabric-themed object we could put in the course let us know in the comments below!

Also, as a reminder, these are the tiers for the wishlist campaign. Keep on wishlisting us and we might be able to add another course!

Tier 1 : 1K wishlists = 1 new course (bringing launch total to 17) and 10% discount on release (1 week)
Tier 2 - 10K wishlists = 1 new course, custom golf ball skins, 20% release discount (1 week)
Tier 3 - 40K wishlists = 2 new courses, custom golf ball skins, 30% release discount (1 week)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232150/OK_Golf_HD/

Also, a reminder, that we still have our demo up as part of the Steam Game Festival, so check us out if you want to try the game before hitting that wishlist button!

Namas-tee!
- Charles

notes.title: Wishlist campaign and new trailer
notes.content:
Hello!

We promised we'd get it to you and here it finally is - our trailer showing off the new look of OK Golf HD!

[previewyoutube=8gp6xGGjm7I;full][/previewyoutube]
As you can see, we've added lush grass everywhere and are really proud of the visuals we've managed to achieve. Please let us know what you think of the new look in the comments below!

We started work on this a while ago, before we were all stuck indoors. For us at least, this game has taken on a whole new meaning now. We needed to remind ourselves of the places that are now so far away, and to have a game we can just relax in while a gentle breeze drifts by. So we did our best to capture those feelings with the game's atmosphere.

[b]Wishlist campaign[/b]

We're also happy to announce a new wishlist campaign. The more people wishlist our game, the more we'll give you at launch. We're starting with 3 tiers, but if we're lucky enough to reach tier 3 then we'll add more.

Tier 1 : 1K wishlists = 1 new course ( bringing launch total to 17 ) and 10% discount on release ( 1 week )

Tier 3 - 40K wishlists = 2 new courses, custom golf ball skins, 30% release discount ( 1 week )

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232150/OK_Golf_HD/

Stay Safe!
- Charles from Okidokico
